summary: Combined the trial platform with all 26 strict-LLM branch commits using a two-parent merge; preserved historical sources and published evidence; added a common nine-track registry and offline preservation checks.
negative_results: The initial test attempt could not write temporary files because the local disk was full. Recording resumed after write space became available; no experiment data was removed.
A sandboxed test run refused loopback bind. The same full suite passed with local loopback permitted.
Historical model errors, partial runs and untested hypotheses remain unchanged.
limitations: No new model inference, native live experiment or production deployment.
Original results apply to their exact historical source/runtime revisions, not this integrated tree.
Seven Linux-only checks and hosted kernel probes require PR CI.
No independent operator, SDK/native adapter unification or new participant admission is established.
Use a merge commit for acceptance; squash/rebase would discard the original branch ancestry from main.
publication_scope: Sanitized integration receipt only; private implementation and raw traces stay outside this public repository.
